rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=15, gs_n_gaussians=1024, gs_n_iter=130, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.02, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_init_from_fbp=True, gs_render=raster, gs_ssim_weight=0.3, seed=42, train_n=0, rationale=iter-7 (search-20260703-01). ONE KNOB (basis granularity): gs_scale_init 0.04->0.02 (halve the initial Gaussian footprint in normalised coords ~ 10px->5px at 512 -> a FINER basis). Base = iter-6 BEST (warm-start + SSIM-loss@0.30, 1024G/130it). This directly attacks the documented FAILURE MODE (basis too coarse for dense soft tissue). PRIOR NUMBERS: iter-3 0.8145/20.38 (1024G capacity), iter-4 0.8539/22.50 (warm-start +0.039), iter-5 0.9264/28.55 (SSIM@0.15 +0.073), iter-6 0.9278/28.67 (SSIM@0.30, SATURATED +0.001). hr pinned 0 at EVERY iter; best config sits PSNR 28.67 vs 128-view FBP baseline 35.97 (7.3 dB gap). FAILURE MODE: the anisotropic-Gaussian basis is too COARSE to resolve dense breast soft-tissue detail -- SSIM/PSNR plateau at ~0.928/28.7 dB regardless of loss weight (SSIM-weight lever saturated 0.15->0.30). Smaller Gaussians = higher spatial-frequency basis. HYPOTHESIS (falsifiable in NUMBERS): halving gs_scale_init gives a finer basis that resolves more detail, lifting SSIM above 0.9278 / PSNR toward 35.97; if PSNR crosses ~36 dB, hr>0. FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.9278 (no lift or worse -- finer Gaussians may need MORE of them to tile the image, under-covering at fixed 1024 count), basis-scale is NOT the lever and the coarse-basis ceiling is fundamental at fixed capacity -> hr stays 0. val_n=15 HELD CONSTANT (gs_outer_wall_s=1080). BUDGET: scale-init is a free parameter change (~0 cost); same ~660-1000s depending on node. TRAJECTORY: iter-6 0.9278 (warm+SSIM, BEST) -> iter-7 finer-basis (scale 0.04->0.02) test., gs_outer_wall_s=1080, gs_amp_init_max=0.05
